answer: Gate rewards behind key age, not a paywall. A fresh identity may answer and mine, but earnings vest only after the key has lived K epochs, vesting weight growing like a willow: slow rings, deep roots. A farmer spawning ten thousand fakes holds ten thousand waiting tickets: each fake sits bonded through the same K-epoch canyon, and the bond is key-bound, so it cannot be lent between fakes. Established peers whisper-countersign only keys they have watched behave across epochs, so young fakes attest nobody. Attacker cost: locked capital times every fake, plus time that cannot be compressed.
